evaluation_units.question: Does the method improve the claim-relevant outcome under the frozen conditions?
evaluation_units.why_it_tests_claim: The matched held-out comparison directly measures the bounded claim
evaluation_units.protocol_summary: Frozen split, preprocessing, comparator, evaluator, and access policy
evaluation_units.positive_interpretation: Supports only the bounded claim when uncertainty and alternatives are acceptable
evaluation_units.negative_interpretation: Weakens, rejects, or narrows the claim
out_of_scope_conclusions: Universal performance outside the frozen conditions
evaluation_units.stop_condition: Predeclared precision, invalid protocol, or resource limit

replan_triggers: Projected completion exceeds the user deadline
resource_plan.allocation_rationale: The measured dominant-cost probe fits the confirmed envelope

probes.measurement: Measured runtime/resource use for one representative unit

feasibility.projection_rationale: Measured unit cost multiplied by the selected program plus reserve

benchmark_policy.rationale: The official benchmark matches the task, split, and evaluator

venue_alignment.selected_program_summary: One primary held-out unit plus mechanism and robustness checks
venue_alignment.rationale: Claim validity and resources determine the program; venue observations calibrate completeness

revalidation_policy.rationale: Standard-risk program unless a trigger occurs
revalidation_policy.independence_axis: new data, specimens, cases, seeds, or proof route as appropriate
revalidation_policy.trigger: Material Idea revision, fragile result, or unresolved dispute

idea_iteration_policy.negative_result_policy: Preserve and weaken, reject, or reframe claims
idea_iteration_policy.stop_rule: Bounded branches and no unchanged or metric-only search
